name: ComfyUI read-only client and graph check
description: Talk to the machine's ComfyUI without queueing anything: system stats and free VRAM, queue depth, a prompt's history and output files, model and combo choices (checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs), and a pre-flight check that every node and model of an API-format workflow exists on that ComfyUI. Never POSTs /prompt, because a missing model can start an auto-download. URL and auth come from the RIGS comfyui settings.

url.description: ComfyUI base URL; default COMFYUI_URL, the saved RIGS setting, then http://127.0.0.1:8188

workflow.description: for check: API-format graph { id: { class_type, inputs } }

dryRun.description: show which endpoints would be read, without any request

outputs: stats: { version, devices[{ name, vramTotalMb, vramFreeMb }] }; queue: { running, pending }; history: { status, outputs[] }; choices/models: option lists; check: { ok, missingNodes[], badValues[{ node, input, value, choices }] }
